subject: Request: supplementary trial credits for 72h burst POC
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightcart.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: eng@brightcart.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: temporary credits for weekend burst POC

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Redwood endpoints look good. We pushed a wider testplan to the team overnight and need to run a 72-hour high-concurrency soak this weekend to validate tail latency and hot-shard behavior for our recommendation endpoint. The initial pilot used the trial bucket, but the burst will exhaust that within ~8 hours.

Can Redwood provision an additional trial credit allocation for a 72-hour window (estimated 180k tokens) and extend our trial by 7 days so we can finish the soak and share performance artifacts back to you? We can start the run as early as 09/26 00:00 PDT.

Attached: brightcart-test-plan.pdf (PDF) — short plan + expected RPS. Also included a small sample of request logs that show our token distribution.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you need more context.

—Sam
Director of ML Engineering, BrightCart
[attachment: brightcart-test-plan.pdf (PDF)]
[attachment: workload-sample-logs.csv (CSV)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: temporary credits for weekend burst POC

Sam — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Looping in Ben (Account Exec) and Priyom (Solutions Eng) to scope the request and approve a provisional top-up. A couple quick Qs to speed approval: 

- Confirmed window: 72 hours starting 09/26 00:00 PDT?
- Do you expect any single-minute spikes >3k RPS (we may need to adjust routing)?
- Are there any restricted data or compliance constraints for the logs we should be aware of?

Ben/Priyom — based on the test plan, their estimate is ~180k tokens. If we can provision a provisional 200k token voucher that expires 72 hours after activation, that should cover the soak plus margin. I can authorize a provisional, but Ben will need to sign off on a promotional extension (7 days) and we should link any formal addendum to the existing PO.

If you approve, I’ll prepare the voucher and a DocuSign MSA addendum with the extension terms for signature. Priyom — can your team standby to monitor and adjust concurrency knobs during the run?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference
[internal note: expedite - client in evaluation funnel stage: mid-market retail]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: temporary credits for weekend burst POC

Vanessa — good catch. Approving the provisional voucher. Details below: 

- Voucher: BRIGHT-PROMO-200K-SEP2026 (200,000 token-equivalent)
- Activation window: customer triggers activation; voucher auto-expires 72 hours after activation
- Trial extension: 7 calendar days from activation date (promotional extension of trial account)
- Notes: provisional credit only — any overage will be billed at standard trial rates unless we agree to a one-off uplift.

Priyom — please prepare a monitoring runbook and have an SRE on-call during the 72h window. Also, attach the MSA addendum draft and send a DocuSign link to Sam once Vanessa confirms.

I’ll create the voucher in the billing portal now and share the activation code.

—Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: MSA-addendum-draft.docx (DOCX)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightcart.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: temporary credits for weekend burst POC

Sam — thanks, we’re set on our side. A few operational details before you flip the switch: 

1) Activation code (will be sent to your account email after DocuSign): BRIGHT-200K-ACT
2) Monitoring plan: we’ll instrument per-token latency sampling at 50ms intervals and expose an RT dashboard (link will be shared). We’ll watch 95/99/99.9 tail percentiles and KV cache hit rates.
3) Fallback policy: if median latency increases >120% or 99.9P exceeds 2s for 10 consecutive minutes, we will throttle to a lower-capacity tier and notify you.

I’ve attached the runbook and a short checklist. Ben — voucher created in billing (voucher id BRIGHT-PROMO-200K-SEP2026). Vanessa — feel free to send the DocuSign link; we’ll provision the credits as soon as it’s signed or we can approve a provisional activation code for immediate use.

Sam — let us know if you want Redwood to kick off the first 6 hours of the run as a joint test. Happy to pair.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
[attachment: runbook-poc-72h.pdf (PDF)]
